Make a memorable entrance in this enchanting bridesmaid dress, featuring a fashion-forward one-shoulder style, adorned with intricate floral detailing and a show-stopping high slit. Designed with the utmost attention to detail, this dress is ideal for formal occasions, such as black-tie weddings, proms, or charity balls, ensuring you'll be the epitome of grace and fashion-forwardness.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
